0022600036.text: The Miami Heat (5-6) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-6) with the Heat sitting second in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and eighth in the East, while riding a two-game winning streak. Miami has gone 1-3 at home and 4-3 on the road, while Cleveland is 4-2 at home and 1-4 on the road, has lost its last two games, and is 5-5 over its last ten. Cavaliers guard Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Cleveland winning the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27.
